observations.what: _recorded_head catches all exceptions silently, returning None. This may hide file not found, JSON decode errors, or permission issues.
refresh_sources uses subprocess.run with a large default timeout (900s) and captures output. There is no handling for subprocess.TimeoutExpired.
Exception handling in refresh_sources catches BaseException (due to BLE001 suppression) and may catch SystemExit, KeyboardInterrupt, etc.
refresh_sources returns a tuple with a single SourceRefresh for early exits, but the return type hint is tuple[SourceRefresh, ...] which is fine.
GateDiscrimination.to_dict converts surviving_critical tuple to list, which may cause asymmetry with constructor that expects tuple.
_gate_binding function signature and docstring are present but the function body is not shown in this chunk.
